questions.content:
A reaction at 1 bar is non-spontaneous at low temperature but becomes spontaneous
at high temperature. Identify the correct statement about the reaction among the
following :

questions.explanation:
We know that G = H TS

At low temperature : G is positive (non-spontaneous process), so H is positive and S is positive (TS < H as T is low).

At high temperature : G is negative (spontaneous process), so H is positive and S is positive (TS > H as T is high).
